tex_content.html:
Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0072, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0073 1. Lemma 2.44\group neckpinch

There is a smoothed family of initial metrics $g_{A,B}$ with positive scalar curvature, slope bound $|\psi _s|\le 1$, a neck of radius $\sqrt A$, a bump of height at least $A\sqrt B$, and uniformly bounded pinching quantity.
